title: Rosemary and Lime Sorbet
changes_from_base: A rosemary-infused milk and cream base sharpened with lime replaces the fruit purée, so this sorbet is creamy rather than fruity.
summary: An unusual creamy sorbet: milk and cream infused with rosemary, then sharpened with plenty of lime.

ingredients.item: light corn syrup or glucose syrup

steps.title: Infuse
steps.text: Put the milk, cream, sugar, corn syrup and rosemary in the large pan and bring just to the boil, watching that it does not rise over the top.

steps.title: Strain and cool
steps.text: Take off the heat, leave for 10 min, then strain into the bowl. Cool, then refrigerate until very cold.

steps.title: Add the lime
steps.text: Whisk the lime juice into the cold base a little at a time, then the zest. If it starts to look grainy, whisk hard or blend for a few seconds.

steps.title: Churn and freeze
steps.text: Churn for 20-25 min, then freeze for 2-3 h. Serve small scoops with a tiny rosemary sprig.

tips: Make sure the base is fridge-cold before adding the lime, or it may split.
Do not steep the rosemary too long, or it tastes medicinal.
Lovely with grilled peaches or fresh figs.
storage: Keep covered with baking paper on the surface in the freezer for up to 1 week. Soften for 5-10 min before scooping.
